title: Ing
description: PheonixSC's "Ing" Ore joke concept taken seriously
body:
The Ing Ore has been one of mystery. Find it and unlock its secrets, intentional or not...

Taking all information from two of PheonixSC's videos; [the original Ing Ore concept](https://youtu.be/_kuLXOknkZA?t=145) and [the coincidental followup](https://youtu.be/SZybGJbV1vI?t=71), I've decided to make the Ing Ore a thing that you can genuinely have fun with.

Visit the [Ing Ore wiki](https://sites.google.com/view/cherritrg/ing-ore) for information!
